newsitem.title: USA: Donnelly forms Brazilian mirror venture.
newsitem.headline: Donnelly forms Brazilian mirror venture.

text.p: Donnelly Corp said Monday it has formed a formed a new joint venture in Brazil to produce interior and exterior mirrors for the growing South American automotive industry.

The venture, named Donnelly/Arteb Ltd, will be based in Sao Paulo and will be 50 percent owned by Donnelly and 50 percent by Industrias Arteb SA, a major Brazilian manufacturer of automotive headlights and taillights.

Arteb is also based in Sao Paulo, and had 1996 sales of more than $90 million. The company has strong customer contacts in South America and employs advanced lean manufacturing processes in combination with a number of sophisticated technical competencies, Donnelly said.
Donnelly said the new venture has already booked new business and is expected to commence operations during the first half of 1998.
The company added that analysts have estimated automakers in Brazil alone will be producing as many as 2.5 million vehicles per year by the year 2000.
